- ALM-000075: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarms are routine background/nuisance reflections that self-cleared without causing traffic degradation.
- ALM-000077: Warning TEMP_HIGH alarms are common on summer afternoons and do not indicate a site failure when KPIs are normal.

- Monitor site S-SAH-009 during upcoming warm afternoons for recurring environmental alarms.
- Inspect feeder cable during the next routine maintenance window to check for minor VSWR reflection.
